name: @graphvis-rs/wasm
description: Rust + WebAssembly port of Graphviz 16.1.0 (all 8 layout engines; byte-identical SVG to C Graphviz on the project's corpus) for browsers, Node.js, Deno, Bun and Workers

scripts.build:wasm: cd .. && CARGO_TARGET_WASM32_UNKNOWN_UNKNOWN_RUSTFLAGS='-C opt-level=z' CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=fat cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown -p gv-wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir web/pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/gv_wasm.wasm && wasm-opt -Oz --enable-bulk-memory --enable-nontrapping-float-to-int --enable-sign-ext --enable-mutable-globals web/pkg/gv_wasm_bg.wasm -o web/pkg/gv_wasm_bg.wasm
